1001 Chicago LLC
727 N. Milwaukee Avenue/1001 W. Chicago Avenue
Residential-Business Planned Development No. 1263
Narrative

I Applicant

1001 Chicago LLC

1001 Chicago LLC, an Illinois limited liability company, is the owner of the property
located at 727 N. Milwaukee Avenue/1001 W. Chicago Avenue (“Property”). The
Property is currently improved with the Spoke mixed-use development, which consists
of two (2) rental apartment buildings, located at 728 and 738 North Morgan St. The
Spoke development was constructed in 2018 pursuant to PD 1263, originally adopted
in 2014. The Property contains the 2-story commercial building component, which
formerly operated as retail space, and is located at 727 N. Milwaukee Ave.

L Lessee
The Goddard School

The Goddard School (“Goddard”) is seeking to lease the above referenced 2-story
commercial building component located at 727 N. Milwaukee Avenue, within the
Property. Specifically, Goddard plans to lease units A, C & D within the 2-story
commercial building component, identified on the site plan (“Leased Premises”).
Goddard is solely engaged in the business of daycare and is not a school. The proposed
daycare facility will be the fifth (5"*) franchise daycare facility established by Goddard
in Chicago, which includes daycare facilities located within the West Loop, South
Loop, Roscoe Village, and Lincoln Park neighborhoods.

i. Existing Site Conditions

As noted above, the Applicant plans to establish daycare operations within the Leased
Premises located at 727 North Milwaukee Avenue, within PD No. 1263. As reflected
in the PD Boundary and Property Line Map, the Leased Premises is located within the
southern portion of PD 1263, and bounded by North Carpenter Street on the north,
North Milwaukee Avenue on the west, and North Morgan Avenue on the south.

17097781 7v1

Il. Proposed Amendment to Residential-Business Planned Development #1263

An amendment to the Property’s existing Residential-Business Planned Development,
is required in order to add “daycare” as a permitted use (to be added to Statement 5.).
Daycare is a permitted use in the underlying DX-5 zoning district.

A. Proposed Planned Development Amendment

The proposed daycare facility will provide daycare for children ages 0-5 and
accommodate 135 children. The number of staff is approximately 18 employees.
Hours of operation will be 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Monday-Friday.

As noted on the site plan, the proposed Leased Premises is identified as Units A, C
& D (“Leased Premises”). Goddard’s proposed daycare facility will operate as
follows:

ly Unit A — daycare facilities for infants within the ground floor of Unit A.;

ii. Unit C — daycare facilities for infants, and children ages 1-5 within the
ground floor of Unit C; and

iii. Unit D - daycare facilities for infants, and children ages 1-5 will operate
within the ground floor, second floor and rooftop area of the Existing
Building.

Goddard’s plans involve interior renovation of the Leased Premises, and there are
no proposed additions or expansion. A total of 28 off-street parking spaces, located
within the second floor of the North Tower building (738 N. Morgan), will be made
available for use by Goddard’s staff and visitors.

As reflected in the enclosed Site/Student Pick-up/Drop-off plan, the applicant
proposes the establishment of safe and secure pick-up and drop-off zones to be
located on i. the east side of West Carpenter Avenue, with direct access to Unit A,
and ii. the west side of Morgan Street, to be located between the loading berth
access area and Milwaukee Avenue. The approximate address for the proposed
pick-up and drop-off zone is 700-710 North Morgan Street and 731-45 North
Carpenter Street. The Applicant plans to file for required standing zone permits for
its proposed hours of operation: 7:00 a.m. — 6:00 p.m., 5 days per week.

The peak hours of the proposed daycare facility is 7:00-900 a.m. and 4:00 — 6:00
p.m.. The average length of time for student drop-off/pick-up is 9-13 minutes.

170977817v1

1. PD uses

The existing uses allowed in PD No. 1263 will remain. The purpose of the proposed
Amendment to PD No. 1263 is to add “daycare” as a permitted use.

2. Community outreach

The Applicant and Goddard have presented the plans to Alderman Burnett and are
in the process of presenting plans to the Neighbors of River West community group.

3. Transportation (Transit-Served Location)

The Property is located within a Transit-Served Location (“TSL”) due to its
proximity to the CTA Blue Station located at Chicago Avenue (716 feet) and the
Chicago Avenue bus line (498 feet). However, the property is zoned PD 1263,
which includes 243 on-site required parking spaces.

4. City Funds or Incentives

Neither Goddard or the Applicant is seeking city financing as part of the proposed
renovation or operation of the daycare facility.

17097781 7v1

FINAL FOR PUBLICATION

STANDARD PLANNED DEVELOPMENT STATEMENTS

The Planned Development Statements describe the legal regulations and conditions that will
control the development of the proposed project. The following statements shall be included in
the ordinance; any proposed changes to these statements must be discussed and reviewed with
the Chicago Department of Planning and Development. Based on the scope of the project,
additional statements (listed at the end of this document) may be required. The following
statements must be included in the ordinance:

1. The area delineated herein as Planned Development Number 1263, as amended, (Planned
Development) consists of a net site area of approximately 90,250 square feet (2.07 acres) of
property which is depicted on the attached Planned Development Boundary and Property
Line Map (Property) and is owned or controlled by the Applicant, 1001 Chicago LLC.

2. The requirements, obligations and conditions contained within this Planned Development
shall be binding upon the Applicant, its successors and assigns and, if different than the
Applicant, the legal title holders and any ground lessors. All rights granted hereunder to the
Applicant shall inure to the benefit of the Applicant’s successors and assigns and, if different
than the Applicant, the legal title holder and any ground lessors. Furthermore, pursuant to the
requirements of Section 17-8-0400 of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Property, at the
time of application for amendments, modifications or changes (administrative, legislative or
otherwise) to this Planned Development are made, shall be under single ownership or
designated control. Single designated control is defined in Section 17-8-0400.

3. All applicable official reviews, approvals or permits are required to be obtained by the
Applicant or its successors, assignees or grantees. Any dedication or vacation of streets or
alleys or grants of easements or any adjustment of the right-of-way shall require a separate
submittal to the Department of Transportation on behalf of the Applicant or its successors,
assigns or grantees.

Any requests for grants of privilege, or any items encroaching on the public way, shall be in
compliance with the Planned Development.

Ingress or egress shall be pursuant to the Planned Development and may be subject to the
review and approval of the Departments of Planning and Development and Transportation.
Closure of all or any public street or alley during demolition or construction shall be subject
to the review and approval of the Department of Transportation.

Pursuant to a negotiated and executed Perimeter Restoration Agreement (“Agreement”) by
and between the Department of Transportation’s Division of Infrastructure Management and
the Applicant, the Applicant shall provide improvements and restoration of all public way
adjacent to the property, which may include, but not be limited to, the following as shall be
reviewed and determined by the Department of Transportation’s Division of Infrastructure
Management:
